$comment: Repositories that .github/workflows/secret-provision.yml may write Actions secrets
into. It is the allowlist for that workflow's `target_repo` input, and it is declared
HERE, in data, rather than as a case statement in the workflow -- same reason
required-checks.json declares `enforce` in data: a list in the workflow is invisible to
anyone auditing who can write where, while a data file is greppable, diffable, and has
an owner in review.
WHY AN ALLOWLIST AT ALL. SECRETS_ADMIN_PAT is deliberately scoped to all repositories,
so that each product's agents can provision their own secrets through this one guarded
workflow instead of every repo holding its own secret-writing credential. That scope is
the point, but it also means the token can reach repositories this workflow has no
business touching. Membership here -- not the token's scope -- is what decides where a
dispatch may land.
ADDING A REPO IS A REAL GRANT. An entry lets any caller who can dispatch
secret-provision.yml (workflow_dispatch, or repository_dispatch with the widely
distributed FUZEINFRA_DISPATCH_TOKEN) create and overwrite Actions secrets in that
repository. Add one when that product's agents genuinely need self-service provisioning,
and say why in `why` so the next reader does not have to guess.
WHAT AN ENTRY DOES NOT GRANT. `source=copy` is refused whenever the target is not this
repository, whatever is listed here: copying a secret cross-repo would move FuzeInfra's
own secret VALUES into another repository, which is exfiltration wearing a re-key's
clothes. Cross-repo dispatches may `generate` a fresh value or `verify` presence only.
The PROTECTED list in the workflow still applies to every target.
Guarded by tests/test_secret_provision_guard.py.

targets.why: This repository. Always permitted -- it is the default when `target_repo` is omitted, and the behaviour the workflow had before the input existed.

$fields.repo: Full owner/repo slug, exactly as GitHub spells it. Matching is case-insensitive because GitHub slugs are.
$fields.why: What this repository needs self-service secret provisioning FOR. Required: an entry nobody can justify in one sentence is an entry to remove.
